reply_text:
*One critical finding — I’d block shipping on it.*

*`src/schedule.js:6–7` — Renewal day is clamped against the source month, not the target month.* This causes skipped months and incorrect anniversary dates. Reproduced:
• Jan 31, 2026 → *Mar 3*, expected Feb 28.
• Feb 28, 2026 with anchor 31 → *Mar 28*, expected Mar 31.
• Jan 31, 2028 → *Mar 2*, expected Feb 29.
• Mar 31, 2026 → *May 1*, expected Apr 30.

*Recommended fix:* use `daysInMonth(year, month + 1)` when clamping, keeping the original `anchorDay`. Add these cases to `test/schedule.test.js`; its current two tests miss month-length transitions.

All 5 existing tests pass. No other findings from the full diff and caller review. No files changed.
